planets.name: HD 21520 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 21520 with a 25.1-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: HD 21520 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 21520. Its orbit and size follow Nies et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
